'''Selepet''' (or '''Selepe''')<ref>{{Cite web |title=OLAC resources in and about the Selepet language |url=http://www.language-archives.org/language/spl |access-date=2024-01-22 |website=www.language-archives.org}}</ref> is a [[Papuan languages|Papuan language]] spoken in [[Selepet Rural LLG]], [[Morobe Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]].
